observation: Personally read museum label Baiera asadai Yabe et Oishi, Ginkgophyta, CH106 specimen photograph. Actual pixels show a narrow basal petiole opening into deeply separated flat long wedge/ribbon lobes, divided unevenly toward tips, preserved on gray slab. Chosen specimen only; no whole-tree features. Museum lists Upper Jurassic/Jehol/Liaoning and 11.5cm; PNAS2021 DOI10.1073/pnas.2107859118 abstract explicitly identifies Jehol as Early Cretaceous, so specimen age/locality is unresolved, not relabelled automatically. Wiley DOI10.1111/nph.20154 read only as comparison: Late Triassic B.multipartita is different material and not used for selected outline.

Personally read Lancaster2009 NPS-hosted article, dune morphology paragraphs and caption. Actual Figure4 pixels show transverse/crescentic ridge perpendicular to wind with asymmetric cross section; Figure5A/B show laterally linked crescentic forms, B broadly continuous ridges. Figure5D/E are linear forms; prose panel lettering conflicts with caption, so actual labels govern. CopyrightGSA consult-only. Batch70 linear-dune inspected only as duplicate guard, no source mesh or geometry reused.

Personally read NPS GrandTeton relative-elevation article: abundant coarse sediment, varying discharge, exposed midchannel bars and interweaving multithread channels. Personally inspected actual NPS/Potter fall photograph, not just LiDAR visualization: broad exposed tapered gravel bars divide blue shallow flow into unequal joining arms; bars and banks are irregular and asymmetric.

Personally read UtahGeologicalSurvey Dugway page: roughly spherical geodes, crystal-lined cavities, most hollow and quartz common; actual geodes3 photograph shows three opened nodules with enclosing rind and pale lining. Personally read IowaGeologicalSurvey page and inspected open Keokuk geode actual photograph: lumpy rounded enclosing exterior, pale small quartz crystals lining irregular inward hollow. Utah text has erroneous Bonneville phrase thousand years; no precise ages propagated. Original FortMatanzas coquina reference is irrelevant and provides NO support for geodes; original inventory remains unchanged.
